audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart gives Level 3 and Level 6 to 'Skill' and First item / Two+ items to Darius, while every why-line says Darius owns Levels 1-6 and Vladimir owns both item stages. diff is 'EVEN' but diffRating is 8/10 with the red HARD tone and 'Hard matchup' text.
audit.why: The packet levelChart is Darius x5 then Vladimir x2, and the 51.82% Emerald+ rate is a Darius-favoured lane that decays into scaling, not an 8/10 counter.
audit.corrected: Chart: Darius Levels 1 through 6, Vladimir from First item on. Difficulty restated as EVEN 5/10 with the neutral tone.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text says 'Sanguine Pool online, level 6, first item' and 'Pool has a long CD early' without ever giving the number.
audit.why: Sanguine Pool is 28/25/22/19/16s and Hemoplague is a flat 120s at every rank — those two numbers are the whole timing game of this lane.
audit.corrected: Pool's 28s rank-1 cooldown and Hemoplague's flat 120s written into the spike and cooldown fields.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Sanguine Pool dodges your execute' is asserted with no mechanism, Tides of Blood is never mentioned at all, and Crimson Pact is never mentioned.
audit.why: Riot's text: Sanguine Pool makes him untargetable for 2 seconds and slows and siphons from anyone standing on the pool — so chasing him onto the puddle feeds him. Tides of Blood costs Vladimir his own health and can be blocked by units in the way. Crimson Pact converts bonus health into AP and AP into health, so he is never a harmless tank. Transfusion is empowered when his resource bar is full, which is the visible tell the TL;DR gestures at.
audit.corrected: Untargetability, the pool's drain, Tides of Blood's health cost and unit-blocking, and Crimson Pact all stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization recommends Plated Steelcaps and never names an anti-heal item, despite 'Anti-heal hard' being the first Do.
audit.why: Vladimir's damage is magic, so Mercury's Treads is the correct boot; Transfusion and Hemoplague both heal him, so Grievous Wounds has to arrive before his first big item, not after.
audit.corrected: Executioner's Calling timing and Mercury's Treads written into the itemization line.

edits.after: Brawl early while Transfusion is still a 9s cooldown, back off when his bar fills and it turns empowered, and never chase him onto the pool — it drains you.
edits.before: Brawl aggressively early on his massive Q cooldowns, step away when his blood bar turns red, and walk alongside his pool puddle without wasting skills.

edits.after: Anti-heal, bait pool, all-in before his first item. Pool is 28s at rank 1 — that gap is your kill window.
edits.before: Anti-heal, bait pool, all-in early. Track Sanguine Pool before every commit and keep the wave on your side.

edits.after: Vladimir wins by pooling out of your commit, healing back through Transfusion, and reaching item scaling.

edits.after: Transfusion is 9s at rank 1 and Tides of Blood costs him his own health, so brawl now. Pool is 28s — force it, step off the puddle so it cannot drain you, and re-commit inside that gap.
edits.before: Vlad’s W dodges your R/combo and his passive out-sustains you. Anti-heal, bait his pool, and all-in early before he scales. Don't chase past the wave into Sanguine Pool.

edits.after: - Vladimir Sanguine Pool: 28/25/22/19/16s, matchup-defining — 2s untargetable, and it slows and siphons anyone standing on it, so walk off the puddle instead of chasing through it. Bait it, then commit. Vladimir Hemoplague: a flat 120s at every rank; it amps the damage you take and heals him per champion hit. Darius Apprehend: 26s at rank 1 — spend it forcing the pool, never predictably.
edits.before: - Vladimir Sanguine Pool: matchup-defining — Dodges your execute. Bait it. Darius E (Apprehend): Long early cooldown. Never throw this out predictably; save it explicitly to interrupt their dash trajectories mid-flight or catch their retreat paths. Darius Ghost: Your primary lethal enabler. Keep this tool ready to completely blow through ranged poke or instant slows across the lane.

edits.after: Vladimir: Pool cooldown falling 28s to 16s, Hemoplague at 6, his first big item. Darius: level 2-3 trade kit, first item, 2-item window.
edits.before: Vladimir: Sanguine Pool online, level 6, first item. Darius: level 2-3 (full trade kit), first item spike, and the 2-item side-lane window.

edits.after: Transfusion and Hemoplague both heal him — buy Executioner's early.
edits.before: Dodges your execute. Bait it. Commit on its cooldown, never into it.

edits.after: Pool is 28s at rank 1. Force it with an early E-pull, step off the puddle so it cannot siphon you, then re-engage inside that window.
edits.before: Pull Vladimir as he steps to last-hit, W slow, land the Q outer ring, weave two autos, and walk away at 3-4 stacks with the heal banked.

edits.after: Pool makes him untargetable for 2s — a Guillotine spent into it is 120s of nothing.
edits.before: That is Vladimir's favourite window — refusing it removes half his win condition.

edits.after: Track Sanguine Pool, 28s at rank 1: 2s untargetable. Force it, then commit while it is down.
edits.before: Track Vladimir's Sanguine Pool: Dodges your execute. Bait it. Engage only while it is down.

edits.after: Start Doran's Shield + pot. Executioner's early — Transfusion and Hemoplague both heal him. Core Stridebreaker then Sterak's; boots Mercury's, not Steelcaps.
edits.before: Start Doran's Shield + pot vs the poke. Core: Stridebreaker (the stickiness fix), then Sterak's Gage / Dead Man's Plate; boots Plated Steelcaps.

edits.after: His R Hemoplague is a flat 120s that amps your damage taken and heals him per champion hit, but a clean all-in still wins if you bait Pool first. Force Pool with an early E-pull, count the 28s, then re-engage.
edits.before: His R Hemoplague amps damage and heals him in fights, but you still win a clean all-in if you bait W Pool first. Force the Pool with an early E-pull, wait it out, then re-engage — Pool has a long CD early.

edits.after: Your edge holds until items arrive. At 6 Hemoplague adds fight healing on a flat 120s, but a disciplined all-in still wins if you bait Sanguine Pool first — it is 28s at rank 1. Force the pool with a pull, step off it, and re-commit before he outscales.
edits.before: Your edge holds until items arrive. At 6 his R Hemoplague adds fight healing, but a disciplined all-in still wins if you bait Sanguine Pool first — its early cooldown is long. Force the Pool with a pull, wait, and re-commit before he outscales.

edits.after: Once Vlad completes an item he flips the lane: 2s of untargetable Pool wastes your R execute, and Transfusion plus Hemoplague heal through your entire bleed. Stop dueling him solo — chain hard CC with your team, since his unkillable teamfight profile only grows.
edits.before: Once Vlad completes an item he flips the lane: Pool dodges both your E-pull damage and R execute, and his Q sustain plus Hemoplague heal through your entire bleed. Stop dueling him solo — chain hard CC with your team, since his unkillable teamfight profile only grows.
